Advertisement for the post of Multi-Task Worker (Driver cum Peon)
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the following temporary posts in Research Project entitled
“Climate, Health and Air Monitoring Project”.
Posts are purely on contract basis and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Post : Multi-Task Worker (Driver cum Peon)(No. of Post: 1)
a) Qualification:
Essential: 10h (Matriculation)
Desirable: Driving experience.
Candidate should have work experience in same field.
b) Salary: Rs. 20000/- per month (fixed)
c) Job Description:
Candidate need to perform duties as trained driver cum Peon, required to do multitask and to assist in the day to
day, project /office work, field visits, and other related work as per need of project
Applications along with bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work experience should reach to the
undersigned latest by 30 April 2026 before 3.00 pm in room no 227, 2nd Floor, Dept of Environment Studies,
Panjab University, Chandigarh
The interview date and time will be informed through email/phone to shortlisted candidates.
No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab University and/or
funding agency will govern the selected candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Principal Investigator
